name: Linux OS for Focused Learning
subtitle: Debian based locked down OS for focused STEM education
description: Built on a minimal Debian install, this project specifically tailored towards K-12 STEM education.
System boots into a restricted environment to maximize student focus and retention on complex topics.
A key feature is Microsoft Makecode, a block coding editor similar to Scratch, which runs a static web app on the system, requiring no internet connection or login
Teachers are able to design customized tutorials for their students on Makecode using a lesson builder application built in Python.
The lesson's are enabled or disabled through a local mDNS network rather than through external cloud providers or services, making it scalable and accesible for remote and small school boards.
Developed as a Computer Science Project course under the supervision of Prof. Stefan Kremer at the University of Guelph.

name: BirdWatcher
subtitle: An image recognition app to gameify bird watching
description: A mobile app to get the younger generation outside to catch 'government bird spies.' using your phone's very camera!
Each photo of a bird taken by a user gets send to a local vision model that correctly identifies its species and type with 99% accuracy.
Once identified, the model connects and send the factual information to OpenAI's API so it can generate unique descriptions for each bird.
The API returns a spy name, and other fictious information that is presented alongside the real facts about the bird to make the learning experience fun and engaging
The entries are stored using Firebase and the application itself is built in Flutter.
I'm currently working on a web version that runs a local open weight model so that it can be hosted without the cost of tokens. It will be published here when finished!
